title: A living ghost town
text: Randsburg is called a living ghost town, and on weekends motorcyclists and tourists stop in to explore the old buildings and visit the general store. Most visitors arrive between autumn and spring because of the extreme heat in summer. Thanksgiving weekend and New Year's Eve are exceptions, when tourists flock into the town.
